sentences.en: It will be all the same a hundred years hence.
sentences.zh: 一百年后，一切都会一样。

sentences.en: "But hence, where leads the path, thy forward steps pursue."
sentences.zh: "但是从此以后，你前行的脚步要跟随那条路引领的方向。"

sentences.en: What will become of the world thirty years hence?
sentences.zh: 三十年后，这个世界会变成什么样？
